mapper.sql: GREATEST( COALESCE(u.update_time, u.create_time), COALESCE(ua.update_time, ua.create_time), COALESCE(a.update_time, a.create_time), COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(GREATEST( COALESCE(r.update_time, r.create_time), COALESCE(ur.update_time, ur.create_time) )) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.app_id = a.id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 ), ua.create_time) )
FROM sys_user_app ua JOIN sys_app a ON a.id = ua.app_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ua.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.code = #{appCode} AND ua.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT u.id AS workspace_user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.email, u.mobile, u.gender, u.dept_id, CASE WHEN u.status = 1 AND ua.status = 1 AND a.status = 1 AND (u.locked_until IS NULL OR u.locked_until <= now()) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.app_id = a.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status, u.status AS user_status, a.status AS app_status, ua.status AS grant_status, u.password AS password_hash, COALESCE(( SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT r.role_code, ',') FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.app_id = a.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 ), '') AS role_codes, AS updated_at
ORDER BY u.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

AND u.username = #{username} LIMIT 1
